# A rock: jittered icosphere 1.0 x 0.8 x 0.7, half in the water when placed at y 0. Rock ramp (876672).
new
add mesh ico-sphere --name Rock --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --location 0 0 0.1
scale 1.0 0.8 0.7
apply
active Rock
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.08 --seed 9
mode object
material new Rock --base-color 0.529 0.400 0.447
shade flat
export rock.glb
